Key presentation is adapted from Nick Coutsos' Keymap Editor, MIT licensed:
https://github.com/nickcoutsos/keymap-editor/tree/e7946792cf674db20ab72ab67fea759fff4c3ccc

Referenced components: app/src/Keyboard/Keys/styles.module.css, Key.js,
KeyValue.js, util.js, and app/src/Keyboard/LayerSelector.js.

The receiver adapts the keycap/behavior-label styling and symbol-size hierarchy
to its SVG renderer. It does not embed the React editor or MoErgo's proprietary
editor. The license is included here and embedded in the generated HTML.
Icons are local symbolic text equivalents of exported icon names.
